semanticChecks: Interprofessional handover: person desired life/difficulty/observations and precise consultation question, not profession names alone. PT basic movement/OT daily activities/ST language-communication-swallowing and overlapping expertise preserved, no single profession assigned all issues. Care worker reports daily events/person words/usual differences, able/difficult parts/conditions and unconfirmed cause or disease unchanged. Sending/receipt/advice clarification/plan change are distinct. Explanation unclear asks, who does which support and permitted change confirmed before implementation. Person wishes/need-to-know sharing and no worker diagnosis/self-designed rehabilitation/food-texture or drink change merely from report retained. Kai club participation/hand arrangement/group speaking and cause not diagnosed retained. Full reading separately retains single-line PT contact and both cause/new plan unconfirmed.

Observation evidence: person sensations/wishes, worker seen behavior and measurement values separate complementary sources. Fatigue statement not replaced by temperature or observed behavior by diagnosis. Known observation time/context distinct from onset, unseen time/range not invented. Unmeasured versus worker feeling hot/room temperature/body temperature separate. Near miss and danger reported/followed up even no injury, no pre-cause blame; team checks environment/equipment/method. Unsupported existing conclusion corrected by facility method with visible change, no medical numeric thresholds. Urgency does not wait for polished record. Lien14:00fatigue/towel-folding stopped twice/unmeasured, unsupported fever+heat cause corrected and change to responsible staff. Full reading preserves body-temperature-or-other measurement not done; questions retain facts and no unauthorized record-history deletion.

Hand hygiene: visible dirt/prior contact/next task checked, running water+soap versus alcohol hand rub distinguished, convenience not sole selection. Visible dirt washes; both hands palm/dorsum/webs/thumb/tips/nail surrounds and facility ring/watch rules, counting repetitions not proof complete. Aftersoap rinse under running water and appropriate drying; alcohol hand rub product quantity/method spread until dry, no paper wipe before drying. Dirty towels/surfaces can recontaminate, new contacts and needed timing checked; gloves not substitute. Quantity/time/product/pathogen choice follows facility infection-control/product instructions/workplace training, no self-made procedure. Full reading specifically includes forthcoming clean-supplies container and both coworkers suggestions, no abbreviated substitution with section case.

Worker capacity: waist load includes person abilities/place/equipment/staff number/roles, wide stance alone not proof safe solo transfer. Own pain/fatigue/unsafe state to responsible staff, hiding pain can harm both parties. Equipment suitable to person/task, pre-use condition and trained method; warehouse presence not model training/joint assignment confirmation. Untrained experience reported, operator/plan/support partner checked. Fully assisted person lifting considers lift use rather than manual strength reliance. No lifting/pulling/transfer/body fulcrum technique taught; individual assessment/equipment handling/workplace training required, no unknown solo trial. Full reading includes coworker correct-standing-posture claim while role/model/own pain limits remain.

Disaster drill follow-up: supplies plus usable route/contact/who supports whom/person information access checked. Bag complete not responsible-person reach proof. Planned versus achieved, failed contact/unusable route separately from attendance, everyone present not safe completion. Incomplete work/reported recipient/responsibility accepted checked by facility plan, roster name not current acceptance and unconfirmed substitute/route not invented. Correction owner/time/method, clearing/recontacting actions versus proven usable route/information/support results separate and carried into next drill/plan review. No universal earthquake/fire/wind-flood evacuation order; actual urgent response follows trained facility instructions without waiting for training report. Hearing-support person responsible contact unreachable and trolley blocks planned path; full reading complete, no inferred correction completion.

Emotion and choice: expression/attitude prompt respectful nonleading inquiry, silence not sadness/anger/refusal. Activity wish versus situational difficulty, noise/hunger/fatigue/anxiety may combine, confirmed words/observations not single guessed cause. Meaningful small choices/method/song/topic/time/company and feasible conditions discussed, activity counts/praise not satisfaction proof. Confirmed wishes/feasible/unconfirmed conditions separated, alone-now wish not all future social rejection. Needs models/expressions not psychological diagnosis or decision-capacity judgment. Individual plan/person wishes/responsible-person concrete information for continuing problems retained. Music case observation silence/door gaze versus wish alone due noise but choose song retained; full reading includes initial worker social-aversion assumption and no diagnostic replacement.

Memory: encoding/retention/recall as distinct processes, prior preferred Bengali terms restored exactly in concept naming. Semantic/episodic/procedural memory and knowledge/experience/body-learned skill separated. Familiar successful task not new schedule-memory proof. Before labeling memory problem check accessible communication/content/question understanding and noisy-place listening conditions. Observed skill/person response/explanation context/unknown areas recorded, short explanation/quiet place/usable method consulted and task-limited understanding/memory verified. One forgotten schedule not disease, skill not whole memory normal guarantee, no dementia-test/decision-capacity substitute. Towel-folding skill versus freshly announced activity time in noisy room separate, actual hearing/meaning still checked, no single-reply diagnosis. Full reading retains worker whole-memory-normal inference as unverified assumption, four rationales distinguish separate processes.
